lado_card.t: A lab company with 12 planted flaws
lado_card.texto: Horizonte Distribuidora is fictional and safe: everything is sample HTML and JSON, with no real keys. Each lesson asks you to find a few flaws.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · Professional 2030 · inema.club · AI risk assessment and triage: this is not a pentest, incident response, or a legal opinion. · This course's page on INEMA.CLUB · Guide: how to learn AI

inicio.titulo: AI Auditor: find, classify, and explain the risks of the AI your company already uses
inicio.lead: Your company already uses AI: apps built with vibe coding, agents on WhatsApp, email integrations, spreadsheets with customer data. In eight lessons, you learn to ask for authorization, build the inventory, classify each risk with evidence, and hand leadership a report with a 30-day plan.
inicio.capa_alt: AI Auditor: assess and triage AI risks with method and evidence. Professional 2030, INEMA.CLUB.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of real work: authorization, inventory, triage, three review fronts (apps, agents, data), governance, and the report.

itens: IT, compliance, controllership, or management professionals who want to help companies use AI safely.
Consultants who already serve small and mid-sized businesses and get asked, "Is this AI we use safe?".
You don't need to code: you read evidence, ask the right questions, and know when to call a specialist.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Write the scope agreement and authorization letter before looking at anything.
Build the company's AI inventory, including "shadow AI".
Classify risks with a matrix based on OWASP (LLM and Agentic) and record the evidence.
Review an AI-built app, an agent that takes actions, and a vendor that receives customer data.
Deliver a one-page executive report and a 30-day plan.
AI risk assessment and triage. It is not a pentest (penetration test), nor incident response, nor a legal opinion.
When a case calls for that, you escalate to a qualified professional: lesson 1 shows you how.
The INEMA certification is a qualification, not a regulated profession, and it does not replace a certified ISO audit.
A program of Professional 2030. Each program will have an INEMA certification; details coming soon.
